problem.statement_latex: An unknown graph $G$ on a known vertex set $[n]$ is accessed by queries $S\subseteq[n]\mapsto[E(G[S])\ne\varnothing]$. Recover its edges, under the matching, cycle, or star promises analyzed by Montanaro--Shao.
